meta.source: Logo PDF (logo blue #2B4AA5) + hamidoseafood.com + Orland Park review round 2 (Young Serif, turquoise secondary)

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page background.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Pale blue ground for alternating sections and cards. Replaces the beige from v1.

tokens.name: foam
tokens.usage: Blue tint fill from the logo blue. Cards and chips on surface; never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface, surface-warm and foam. 15:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (hours labels, captions) on surface and surface-warm. 5.7:1+.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: PRIMARY ACCENT, the brand blue from the logo file. Primary buttons, links, headings accents, logo, focus ring. White text on it is 8:1.

tokens.name: on-sea
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sea fill. 7.8:1+.

tokens.name: sea-ink
tokens.usage: Links and small blue text on surface and surface-warm.

tokens.name: sea-deep
tokens.usage: Deep navy fill: footer, story slideshow, reviews band. Text on it is white or foam; eyebrows on it are turquoise-bright.

tokens.name: turquoise
tokens.usage: SECONDARY ACCENT (Mediterranean turquoise, the Alexandria harbor). Fills, icons, stars, dividers, active indicators. Not for small text on white (3.4:1).

tokens.name: turquoise-ink
tokens.usage: Turquoise for small text: eyebrows and labels on surface and surface-tint. 5.4:1+.

tokens.name: turquoise-bright
tokens.usage: Turquoise eyebrows, stars and dots on sea-deep (7.4:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on surface.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Young Serif (Google Fonts, one weight: 400). Headlines get hierarchy from size, never bold. The logo's script and bold sans stay in the logo only.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter, shared with the Astoria site.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Pick your fish at the counter, tell the chef how to cook it, and we'll seat you.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Served with Egyptian salad, tahini, rice and fresh pita.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above headings, in brass.

groups.name: Arabic
groups.note: Aref Ruqaa, kept from Astoria as the heritage thread.

styles.name: arabic-accent
styles.usage: One short Arabic line per section, max. Decorative, always paired with English.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between heading and content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, images.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero media, large panels.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, and arch-topped image frames (top corners only).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards and the sticky order bar. From the original's ink-tinted shadows.
